en: This here's MAP 01!
note: Debug/placeholder narration line (Ryoma-style slang); translated literally.

en: Welcome to the Saotome Institute. $s80$s13%3Ryoma Nagare%0.
Old man! $s80$s13Dragging me off to a place like this out of nowhere! $s80$s13$s80$s13What the hell do you want with me?!
Questions can wait. $s80$s13$s80$s13For now, you're going to climb into this.
Wh-$s80$s13What the hell is this?! $s80$s13G...$s80$s13Giant ro-$s80$s13$s20robot?!

In that school building over there is a pilot candidate, $s80$s13$s13%3"Hayato Jin"%0.$/$s80$s13$s13Some time ago, fed up with the academy's corruption, he formed an opposition group. $s80$s13$s13He went to war with the academy head-on.$/$s13Normally, movements like that end up crushed by the academy, $s80$s13$s13but the IQ 300 genius "Hayato Jin"... $s80$s13$s13he was different.$/$s13Through swift action, solidarity, $s80$s13$s13and above all Hayato Jin's intellect, he brought the academy to its knees.$/$s13Ever since, that academy has been known as "Hayato's school."
$s80$s13$s05Heh, $s80$s13$s13sounds like quite the big shot. So I just gotta talk him into it?
That's right.
And $s80$s13this is what you'll use to persuade him?
note: 'this' = the Getter machine Saotome just showed Ryoma (referent inferred from the previous rows).

en: $s80$s13It worked that way with Ryoma too. $s80$s13$s13Showing him the real thing beats talking any day!
note: Male-player version (portrait $f61), rough register. Answers Michiru. Honorific -san dropped throughout ('Ryoma').

en: Look at Ryoma's case. $s80$s13With someone who seems difficult, $s80$s13showing the real thing works faster than words, doesn't it?
$s80$s13$s05Heh, $s80$s13$s13can't argue with that.
So this is the place, $s80$s13$s13this "Hayato's school."
$s80$s13$s05Who's there?!
Go get Hayato for me.
Hayato won't see the likes of you!
$s30Heh heh heh...
H-$s80$s13Hayato!
$s20Stir up trouble in my school, $s80$s13$s20and you won't get off lightly.
No wonder old man Saotome picked you. You've got a good look in those eyes.
note: Addressed to Hayato (inferred: Ryuji's next line objects to how he is talking to Hayato); Japanese has no explicit 'you'.

en: $s05You bastard! $s80$s13$s05How dare you talk to Hayato like that!
A certain man asked me to come pick you up. $s80$s13So how about you come along quietly, $s80$s13Mr. Hayato?
You can't keep playing revolution with these guys forever. $s80$s13There's a battlefield out there that suits you a lot better.
$s05What?!
$s05Ryoma! $s80$s13An enemy's headed your way right now!
$s05Ryoma! $s80$s13Heading for the academy right now $s80$s13is an unidentified enemy!
note: Female-player version, polite report register. Word order inverted so the pause falls where the Japanese has it.

en: $s05Yeah! $s80$s13I can see it!
I've launched $s80$s13the Jaguar-Gou from here! $s80$s13Get Hayato aboard it!
$s80$s13I was only half-convinced till now, $s80$s13$s80$s13but looks like what old man Saotome's been saying is true!
Wh-whoa...! $s80$s13$s30That thing is...
$s05That's right! $s80$s13$s05The enemy.
$s80$s13$s05Damn! $s80$s13$s05There's more than one?! $s80$s13$s05I can't keep up like this!
$s05Let me off this thing!
$s05Either way, $s80$s13that's the only way to survive!$/$m21dCombine%0!
note: The source has a closing %0 with no opening colour code after $m21d; kept as is, closing after 'Combine'.

en: $s05Waaaaah--
$s05What the?! $s80$s13$s13What was that?!
A beam weapon?!
note: Male-player version (identical text in both variants).

en: A beam weapon?!
note: Female-player version (identical text in both variants).

en: Are they with those guys?! $s80$s13$s13Or is it someone else...
note: 'those guys' = the enemies already being fought; the beam came from an unknown third party. Trails off as in the source.

en: $s80$s13Even I can't say.$/$m21d$s05For now, focus on the enemy in front of you!
$s05Wh-whoa... $s80$s13$s80$s13Wh-$s80$s13what ARE these things?!
That's right. $s80$s13To defeat these fiends, $s80$s13the enemies of mankind, $s80$s13we need you!
$s80$s13...$s80$s13Hmph, $s80$s13even if I say no, $s80$s13you'll just drag me along anyway, right?
$s05Really?!
note: Male-player version (portrait $f61) of the reaction to Hayato agreeing.

en: $s05All right!
That's more like it! $s80$s13$s80$s13I'm counting on you from here on out! $s80$s13Hayato! $s80$s13And $s80$s13$s00%2$n%0$s13 too!
I'm heading your way myself in the Bear-Gou!
$s20I get it, $s80$s13without that, we wouldn't stand a chance!

$s05Line up all three Get Machines! $s80$s13That should add %2"Combine"%0 to your commands!$/But be careful. $s80$s13You can't combine after you've already taken an action! $s80$s13If that happens, $s80$s13wait until the next turn!
$s20Fine, $s80$s13$s20I've made up my mind... $s80$s13$s20I'll ride the damn thing.
This is Hayato's school. $s80$s13Hurry up and go persuade Hayato!
$s05You blockhead! $s80$s13Why aren't you combining?! $s80$s13$s05No matter how many you take down with the Get Machines, you'll never handle this many enemies. $s80$s13Combine, now!
That's Getter-1!$/It's well balanced in both attack and defense. $s80$s13It's the most dependable machine we have. $s80$s13It can use the powerful %2"Getter Beam"%0 weapon!
That's Getter-2!$/It uses little energy, so it lets you %2"fight while conserving Getter Energy"%0. $s80$s13It also moves well on the ground!
That's Getter-3!$/$s20It may not look like much... but $s80$s13%2its underwater attack and mobility are very high!%0 $s80$s13Used right, it'll be a formidable asset!
Sorry to keep you waiting, $s80$s13Ryoma.$/What about Hayato?! $s80$s13Did you get him into the Jaguar-Gou?
Been waiting for you, Doc! $s80$s13Took some doing, but I got him in. $s80$s13It's flying on autopilot right now.
$s05Let me out of here! $s80$s13$s05Why do I have to do this?!
$s05Shut up! $s80$s13You and me both got marked by that demon Saotome! $s80$s13$s05Call it fate and brace yourself!
This here's MAP 02!
Allow me to introduce him. $s80$s13He volunteered of his own accord, $s80$s13our third pilot, $s80$s13$s80$s13%3Musashi Tomoe%0!
I trained in Hokkaido $s80$s13on Daisetsuzan! $s80$s13Toyo High School $s80$s13Judo Club $s80$s13captain, $s80$s13$s80$s13I'm Musashi Tomoe!
Whoa, whoa... $s80$s13Is this guy gonna be okay...?
Imagine anyone actually wanting to fight those things. Takes all kinds.
Now, now, $s80$s13isn't it enough that he's willing to pilot?
note: Male-player version ($f61); this one is polite in the source too.

en: Now, now, $s80$s13we're short on people, $s80$s13and this is an emergency...
Father, $s80$s13what on earth were those enemies?
I can't say. $s80$s13Judging by the shape of the creatures that came out of the wreckage, there's no doubt they're some evolved form of %3reptile%0, but...
$s80$s13Reptiles?
$s05We've got a reading near Mt. Asama's crater! $s80$s13$s05Probably the same as last time...
$s05It's them!
$s80$s13Heh! $s80$s13I don't get the complicated stuff, but I can tell you this much!$/$f00g$s05Those bastards are the enemies of us humans! $s80$s13$s05We're launching!
$s05What did you say?!
note: Reaction to Gore's self-introduction, which is not in this script (probably a voiced/cutscene line elsewhere).

en: $s05The Underground Demon King?!
$s05%3Gore%0, you say?!
$s05Rule the surface again, you say?!
note: Male-player version ($f61; female counterpart MF02_05C4 is in mform_01). Object 'the surface' inferred: Gore's later lines say his race ruled the surface before humans.
